Lecture 06 / Dynamic programming

Approximate DP and information states

The limits of exact computation, rollout and approximate values, with an introduction to partial observations.

Planned date Oct 27, 2026Proposed outline

Learning objectives

  • Identify when a chosen state omits decision-relevant information.
  • Explain the purpose of belief or augmented states.
  • Describe how approximation and rollout extend exact planning.

Selected MIT 6.231 lectures on imperfect information and approximate DP.
